direct_main_push_impossible.details: Production automation contains no supported direct-main writer. State changes use isolated state branches and protected PR merge. The obsolete validateDirectMainPushWhitelist implementation and declaration have been removed because production has zero consumers.

immutable_state_transition.details: requestMilestoneStateTransition serializes milestone state and captures packageId/fromStatus/toStatus/message before enqueue. setPackageStatus captures and validates the old status before mutation.

one_state_step_per_tick.details: Both new and pending state transitions call advanceStateTransition exactly once per supervisor tick. WAITING_CI persists nextRetryAt and returns without sleeping or polling.

authorized_merge_adoption.details: Merged-state adoption requires a complete v2 receipt with non-empty hash-verified desiredFiles and non-empty authorized head/check/app authority. It proves PR head equality, trusted exact-head CI, MERGED state, merge reachability from fetched origin/main, and exact desired content.

merge_head_pin.details: State and package merge paths re-check PR head, remote branch head, and trusted exact-head CI immediately before invoking gh pr merge with --match-head-commit and without --admin.

generation_aware_launch_intent.details: Launch matching uses canonical generationMessage(packageId, generation), exact workflow, directional bounded time, and canonical branch worktree identity when available. Blocked intents are re-evaluated; zero or multiple matches remain blocked. Completion requires matching package generation and RUNNING or PROVEN milestone status.

repair_route_execution.details: package-land persists exact-head CODEX/AGY repair requests. The existing autopilot consumes one request step per tick. The state machine creates a real worktree, persists an invocation uncertainty barrier, calls the existing Codex or AGY writer adapter, inspects the committed Git diff, validates ownership, proves a descendant commit, lease-pushes it, verifies the remote SHA, and persists newHeadSha before COMPLETE.

generation_state_only_classifier.details: STATE_ONLY generation changes reuse the same canonical next-generation validator as supervisor restart. Only a non-negative integer N to N+1 transition is accepted; jumps, resets, and removal fail closed to FULL CI.

verdictReason: Production source closes the reviewed defects, but an overall PASS remains unproven until AGY-owned tests are updated for the removed obsolete whitelist API, real Git-backed repair facts, authority-bound intent completion, and asynchronous one-step protected state/planning landings.
